angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 656,045 km at 12.59 pc = 0.7 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 79.4482 +/- 0.0429 mas (same row, RUWE 0.86): 12.59 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.943 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Bourrier et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of 55 Cnc e in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...619A...1B/abstract): 656,045 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.905 +/- 0.015 solar masses from Bourrier et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of 55 Cnc e in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...619A...1B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5172 +/- 18 K from Bourrier et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of 55 Cnc e in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...619A...1B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Bourrier et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of 55 Cnc e in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...619A...1B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-75732.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.446, rounded to two decimals
